records.text: bool phy_ass_ch() { return phy_TimingOk && phy_classes_in_range_ch; }
bool phy_gar_ch() { return phy_classes_in_range_ch; }
bool phy_ass_sig() { return phy_ConfigAdmissible && phy_classes_in_range_sig; }
bool phy_gar_sig() { return phy_classes_in_range_sig; }
bool phy_ass_bm() { return phy_BeamCmdAdmissible && phy_classes_in_range_bm; }
bool phy_gar_bm() { return phy_classes_in_range_bm; }
bool phy_ass_sq() { return phy_fresh_child_reports && phy_gar_ch() && phy_gar_sig() && phy_gar_bm(); }
bool phy_gar_sq() { return true; }
bool phy_ass_ph() { return phy_gar_ch() && phy_gar_sig() && phy_gar_bm() && phy_gar_sq(); }
bool phy_gar_ph() { return true; }
bool phy_ass_env() { return phy_TimingOk && phy_ConfigAdmissible && phy_BeamCmdAdmissible && phy_NetDeliveryOk; }
bool mac_gP0() { return mac_resourceClass == mac_RES_EXHAUSTED || mac_mappedResourceClass == mac_RES_EXHAUSTED; }
bool mac_gP1() { return mac_bufferClass == mac_B_OVERFLOW || mac_delayClass == mac_D_VIOLATED; }
bool mac_gP2() { return mac_queueClass == mac_Q_CRIT && mac_commDemand == mac_COMM_CRITICAL; }
bool mac_gP3() { return mac_sensingDemand == mac_SENS_CRITICAL && mac_sdn_sensing_priority_allowed; }
bool mac_gP4() { return mac_resourceClass == mac_RES_TIGHT && mac_sensingDemand != mac_SENS_NOMINAL && mac_commDemand != mac_COMM_NOMINAL; }
bool mac_gP5() { return mac_kpiFreshnessClass == mac_KPI_STALE || mac_kpiFreshnessClass == mac_KPI_MISSING; }
bool mac_gP6() { return mac_resourceClass == mac_RES_FREE || mac_resourceClass == mac_RES_BALANCED; }
bool mac_gP7() { return true; }

void mac_update_policy_counter() { mac_policy_enabled_count = 0; if (mac_gP0()) mac_policy_enabled_count++; if (mac_gP1()) mac_policy_enabled_count++; if (mac_gP2()) mac_policy_enabled_count++; if (mac_gP3()) mac_policy_enabled_count++; if (mac_gP4()) mac_policy_enabled_count++; if (mac_gP5()) mac_policy_enabled_count++; if (mac_gP6()) mac_policy_enabled_count++; if (mac_gP7()) mac_policy_enabled_count++; }

void mac_select_mac_policy() { mac_update_policy_counter(); mac_silent_accept = false; if (mac_gP0()) { mac_scheduleMode = mac_SCH_CONSTRAINED; mac_macReason = mac_REASON_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; mac_mac_report_pending = true; } else if (mac_gP1()) { mac_scheduleMode = mac_SCH_COMM; } else if (mac_gP2()) { mac_scheduleMode = mac_SCH_COMM; } else if (mac_gP3()) { mac_scheduleMode = mac_SCH_SENS; } else if (mac_gP4()) { mac_scheduleMode = mac_SCH_JOINT; mac_macReason = mac_REASON_SENS_COMM_CONFLICT; } else if (mac_gP5()) { mac_scheduleMode = mac_SCH_CONSTRAINED; mac_macReason = mac_REASON_STALE_PHY_KPI; } else if (mac_gP6()) { mac_scheduleMode = mac_SCH_JOINT; } else { mac_scheduleMode = mac_SCH_CONSTRAINED; } }
bool sdn_telemetry_bad() { return sdn_telemetryClass == sdn_TEL_STALE || sdn_telemetryClass == sdn_TEL_MISSING; }
bool sdn_gPolReject() { return sdn_riskClass == sdn_RISK_CRIT || sdn_sliceClass == sdn_SLICE_VIOLATED || sdn_recoveryClass == sdn_REC_FAILED; }
bool sdn_gPolConstrained() { return sdn_telemetry_bad() || sdn_riskClass == sdn_RISK_HIGH || sdn_sliceClass == sdn_SLICE_WARN; }

bool sdn_gPolReroute() { return (sdn_ruleClass == sdn_RULE_MISS || sdn_link_failure_pending || sdn_node_failure_pending) && (sdn_standby_available || sdn_alternative_config_exists) && !sdn_telemetry_bad(); }
bool sdn_gPolSensingBoost() { return sdn_sensing_degradation_pending && !sdn_telemetry_bad() && sdn_riskClass != sdn_RISK_CRIT; }
bool sdn_gPolCommPrio() { return sdn_service_request_pending && sdn_sliceClass != sdn_SLICE_VIOLATED && !sdn_telemetry_bad(); }
bool sdn_reconfig_allowed() { return sdn_telemetryClass == sdn_TEL_FRESH && sdn_policyClass != sdn_POL_CONSTRAINED && sdn_policyClass != sdn_POL_REJECT; }

void sdn_update_policy_counter() { sdn_policy_enabled_count = (sdn_gPolReject()?1:0) + (sdn_gPolConstrained()?1:0) + (sdn_gPolReroute()?1:0) + (sdn_gPolSensingBoost()?1:0) + (sdn_gPolCommPrio()?1:0) + 1; }

void sdn_classify_risk() { if (sdn_recoveryClass == sdn_REC_FAILED || sdn_sliceClass == sdn_SLICE_VIOLATED || sdn_telemetryClass == sdn_TEL_MISSING) sdn_riskClass = sdn_RISK_CRIT; else if (sdn_ruleClass == sdn_RULE_TIMEOUT || sdn_sensing_degradation_pending) sdn_riskClass = sdn_RISK_HIGH; else if (sdn_telemetryClass == sdn_TEL_STALE || sdn_sliceClass == sdn_SLICE_WARN) sdn_riskClass = sdn_RISK_MED; else sdn_riskClass = sdn_RISK_LOW; }

void sdn_select_sdn_policy() { sdn_update_policy_counter(); sdn_optimistic_reconfig = false; if (sdn_gPolReject()) { sdn_policyClass = sdn_POL_REJECT; sdn_serviceImpact = sdn_IMPACT_REJECTED; sdn_sdnReason = sdn_SDN_POLICY_REJECT; } else if (sdn_telemetry_bad()) { sdn_policyClass = sdn_POL_CONSTRAINED; sdn_serviceImpact = sdn_IMPACT_DEGRADED; sdn_sdnReason = sdn_SDN_STALE_TELEMETRY; } else if (sdn_gPolReroute()) { sdn_policyClass = sdn_POL_REROUTE; sdn_serviceImpact = sdn_IMPACT_NONE; sdn_sdnReason = sdn_SDN_NONE; } else if (sdn_gPolSensingBoost()) { sdn_policyClass = sdn_POL_SENS_BOOST; sdn_serviceImpact = sdn_IMPACT_DEGRADED; sdn_sdnReason = sdn_SDN_SENSING_FAILURE; } else if (sdn_gPolCommPrio()) { sdn_policyClass = sdn_POL_COMM_PRIO; sdn_serviceImpact = sdn_IMPACT_NONE; sdn_sdnReason = sdn_SDN_NONE; } else { sdn_policyClass = sdn_POL_NORMAL; sdn_serviceImpact = sdn_IMPACT_NONE; sdn_sdnReason = sdn_SDN_NONE; } }
void raise_app_service_request_seq() { if (!app_service_request_seq) { app_service_request_seq = true; app_service_request_seq_age = 0; } }
void raise_app_sla_warn_seq() { if (!app_sla_warn_seq) { app_sla_warn_seq = true; app_sla_warn_seq_age = 0; } }

void raise_app_fa_critical_seq() { if (!app_fa_critical_seq) { app_fa_critical_seq = true; app_fa_critical_seq_age = 0; } }
void raise_app_miss_critical_seq() { if (!app_miss_critical_seq) { app_miss_critical_seq = true; app_miss_critical_seq_age = 0; } }
